units.source_text: 源氏请托住在东院西殿里的花散里当夕雾的保护人，

en.t: Genji asked Hanachirusato, who lived in the western wing of the East Palace, to become Yugiri's guardian,

units.source_text: 对她言道：“太君年老，在世之日恐不多了。

en.t: and said to her, "The lady is old, and I fear she has few days left in this world.

units.source_text: 我把这孩子托付与你，让他从小亲近你。

en.t: I entrust this child to you, so that he may grow close to you from childhood.

units.source_text: 那么太君百年之后，有你照拂他了。”

en.t: Then, after the lady has passed away, you will be there to look after him."

units.source_text: 花散里对源氏，向来惟命是听，便一口答应，从此疼爱夕雾，用心照顾他。

en.t: Hanachirusato had always obeyed Genji in everything, so she agreed at once, and from then on she cherished Yugiri and cared for him attentively.

units.source_text: 夕雾常得隐约窥见花散里的容颜。

en.t: Yugiri often managed to catch faint glimpses of Hanachirusato's face.

units.source_text: 他想：“这位继母相貌真难看啊！

en.t: He thought, "This stepmother of mine really is unattractive!

units.source_text: 这样的人，父亲也舍不得她。”

en.t: Even someone like this, Father cannot bear to let go."

units.source_text: 又想：“我贪图相貌标致而苦恋这个不得见面的云居雁，太没有意思了。

en.t: Then he thought again, "It is foolish of me to be so painfully in love with Kumoi no Kari, whom I cannot even see, merely because I long for beauty.

units.source_text: 还不如另找一个像花散里那样性情柔顺可亲的人吧。”

en.t: It would be better to find someone gentle and approachable, like Hanachirusato."

units.source_text: 但转念又想：“同一个相貌难看的人对面相处，也太乏味了。

en.t: But then he reconsidered and thought, "Still, living face to face with someone unattractive would be terribly dull.

units.source_text: 父亲多年来照顾这个花散里，但他早已知道这人的相貌与性情，所以对她不即不离，恰到好处。

en.t: Father has looked after this Hanachirusato for many years, but because he has long known both her looks and her nature, he keeps just the right distance from her, neither too close nor too distant.

units.source_text: 正如古歌中所谓‘犹如密叶重重隔’，确是有道理的。”

en.t: As the old poem says, 'like dense leaves layered between them,' and there is real sense in that."

units.source_text: 他觉得这种无聊的想法有些可耻。

en.t: He felt somewhat ashamed of such idle thoughts.

units.source_text: 他的外祖母太君虽然作尼姑打扮，但相貌还很清秀。

en.t: Although his maternal grandmother, the lady, dressed as a nun, her face was still quite refined.

units.source_text: 此外他在各处看惯的，都是相貌美丽的人。

en.t: Besides, the people he was used to seeing everywhere were all beautiful in appearance.

units.source_text: 只有这花散里，本来相貌不扬，年纪渐渐老起来，身体也瘦了，头发也稀少了，所以更教人看不上眼。

en.t: Only Hanachirusato had never been much to look at; as she gradually grew older, her body became thin and her hair sparse, making her seem still less pleasing to the eye.
